summary: Threaded steel 90° L-bracket with two equal legs and a row of five holes on an 8 mm pitch in each leg.

mountingSurfaces.description: Underside of the horizontal leg, which sits flat on a U-channel face
Outer face of the vertical leg, which mounts flat plates or brackets

notes: No dimensions were given. Stated: 5 holes, 8 mm grid, 32 mm between end holes. Insight #5 says outer vertical faces of brackets on a 32 mm square pattern are 48 mm apart, so each hole row sits about 8 mm from its outer face. Assumed: length 40 mm (4 mm end margin beyond the end holes), legs 16 mm each, sheet thickness about 2 mm, hole diameter 4 mm for M4 (the true tapped size is smaller). Hole positions assume the vertical-leg row is 8 mm above the base. Pencil and grid mat in the photo look consistent with a 40 x 16 x 16 mm part, but they were not measured. The 12.9 g weight was not used for sizing.
